datasets: Vidgen et al. hate speech dataset
Qian et al. hate speech datasets
outputs: Counterfactually augmented texts (CADs) that flip the label of the original instance from sexist to non-sexist or hateful to non-hateful
counterfactual examples (CADs) for sexism and hate speech detection
The paper generates counterfactual text instances by making minimal changes to original texts to flip their labels (e.g., from sexist to non-sexist).

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated tasks to single 'Counterfactual Text Generation', normalized model names, simplified dataset names to standard citations, and consolidated output descriptions.
Normalized metric names and removed redundant entries. All metrics are correctly identified as automatic evaluation metrics.
Correct extraction - no LLMs were used as judges/evaluators post-generation.

guideline: Annotators independently labeled each CAD to determine whether it correctly flips the original label without seeing the original instance

criteria: label correctness (whether CAD flips the original label)

changes_made.explanation: Consolidated criteria and simplified guideline description while maintaining accuracy.

overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on NLG (counterfactual text generation) evaluation using both automatic metrics and human assessment. The metadata was well-extracted but needed some normalization for consistency. The human evaluation was correctly identified as assessing label correctness of generated counterfactuals.
